description: This PHP source file defines the 'Extension' class within the OpenCart admin startup controllers. The class manages the registration of extension-related components such as controllers, models, libraries, templates, languages, and configs during the startup process.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: Controller class responsible for loading and registering extension components during startup.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Load extension data from the database and register controllers, models, libraries, templates, language files, and config paths for each installed extension.
